sections.heading: Setting up Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tuition in Mumbai for a full term
paragraphs: Hiring for a term is a different purchase from hiring for an evening, and the brief should look different too. The useful message tells us the shape of the arrangement you want: 'Year 11, History 0470, one ninety-minute session a week from now until the mocks, Tuesday or Thursday at 7pm, Khar West, we want written feedback monthly.' That is a brief a tutor can accept or decline honestly. 'Looking for a History tutor' is the beginning of a conversation about availability that will take three days and may end nowhere.

Availability is the thing most families underweight and most arrangements die of. A tutor who is free in July is not necessarily free in November, because by then their Year 11 board slots are full and yours is the one that gets moved. So the shortlist we build for an ongoing engagement is filtered on whether the tutor can hold your specific slot through to study leave, with the December mock fortnight and the February revision crunch already accounted for. A brilliant IGCSE home tutor in Mumbai who can only commit to eight weeks is the wrong hire for a Year 10 and the right hire for a March emergency.

After that the filters are ordinary. Which depth study the school chose, because a tutor who has taught it to examination works faster than one meeting it for the first time. Whether the cohort sits coursework or the written alternative. What the last two marked answers looked like. Whether your child has ever worked with a tutor before, since a first-time student needs a slower start and a parent who understands that.

You then take one working session before committing to anything longer. The tutor arrives, works for the agreed length, and sends a short written diagnosis the next day. Only after you have read that do you confirm the standing slot, the rate, the session length, what marking is included and how much notice either side gives. Putting those five things in writing takes one message and prevents almost every argument that happens later in a long engagement.

sections.heading: Which Cambridge route, and how long should the engagement run?
paragraphs: Two engagement shapes cover almost every family. A term-long engagement runs from the start of the school year to study leave and treats History as a subject being learned. An exam-term engagement starts after the December mocks and treats History as a paper being prepared for. They need different tutors, different session lengths and different money, and confusing them is the most expensive mistake on this page.

Before either one, establish what your child is actually entered for. History 0470 sits under Cambridge International Education across Years 9 to 11. It is not Middle Years Programme (MYP) Individuals and Societies, not International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) History and not ICSE History and Civics, and several Mumbai schools switch cohorts between systems at the end of Year 9 without ever spelling it out to parents. A History (0470) IGCSE Years 9-11 tutor Mumbai families engage on the wrong assumption spends the first fortnight teaching skills the examiner will never ask for.

The term-long shape suits a Year 10, a Year 11 with real content gaps, and any student whose school reports say the knowledge is there and the writing is not. It assumes one session a week for most of the year, homework between, and a slow build from note-making to timed answers. It is cheaper per week of benefit and more expensive in total, because there are simply more weeks in it. It is also the only shape that can fix a depth study the student never properly learned the first time.

The exam-term shape is narrower and sharper. It assumes content is broadly in place, and spends every session on question types, timing and markscheme language, with a volume of written answers that would exhaust a Year 10. It can move a grade. It cannot rebuild a year, and a History (0470) tutor in Mumbai who accepts an exam-term engagement for a student with no notes is accepting a job that cannot be done. Ask the tutor which shape they think your child needs after the diagnostic session, and take the answer seriously even when it costs more than you hoped.
bullets: Term-long: start of year to study leave, one session a week, content plus technique
Exam-term: after the December mocks, question types and timing only

sections.heading: How many hours a week actually move a History grade?
paragraphs: One ninety-minute session a week moves a History grade for most students, provided the student writes something between sessions. Two sessions a week help a Year 11 with a genuine content gap. Three almost never helps anyone, because History improves through writing and reflection, and a student in session three days out of seven has no clear stretch of time left in which to write anything of their own.

The arithmetic is worth saying plainly. Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tuition in Mumbai bought as one session a week across a school year gives you roughly thirty working sessions, minus Diwali, minus a school trip, minus two illnesses. That is enough to cover the depth study properly, drill Paper 2 source technique to the point where utility questions stop frightening the student, and run perhaps eight or nine timed Paper 1 answers under proper conditions. It is not enough to also rebuild two years of absent notes, which is why the diagnostic session matters.

Where the hours go changes across the year. Early on, more of the session goes to the depth study and to making notes that can actually be revised from, because most students arrive with pages that cannot be used. By the middle of Year 11 the balance tips towards Paper 2 source investigation, which is the component that rewards drilling most reliably: provenance, cross-referencing, and what a source is useful for rather than whether it is true. In the final stretch almost everything goes to Paper 1 structured questions under time, because that is where stamina and ordering decide the mark.

The homework multiplier is the number nobody quotes. A ninety-minute session with no writing between produces a student who understands History and cannot do it. Assume an hour of written work set between sessions, and tell the tutor if that hour is not happening, because the lesson plan has to change if it is not. Families who protect that hour see movement in six weeks. Families who do not see movement in a term and then blame the tutor, usually unfairly.

Three sessions a week leaves no time to write, which is where marks come from

sections.heading: Holding a weekly slot across Mumbai for thirty weeks
paragraphs: A standing weekly slot is a promise the tutor makes about traffic in a city that does not cooperate, and the geography decides which promises can be kept. In Mumbai, Maharashtra the honest rule is that tutors hold slots along their own corridor and lose them across it. That is why we match within a line rather than across one, and why an arrangement that looked fine in June starts slipping in the monsoon when the same journey takes half an hour longer every week.

In South Mumbai, where Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Walkeshwar and Peddar Road families sit close together, distance is never the problem and the evening signals are: the Peddar Road and Haji Ali stretch can swallow forty minutes between Worli and Colaba, so tutors here are matched within the island, with the Coastal Road and Metro Line 3 making Lower Parel and Cuffe Parade slots more reliable than they used to be. In the Western Suburbs the Western Line and the Western Express Highway run the whole arrangement: Khar to Santacruz West or Bandra to Juhu holds for a year, Bandra to Borivali does not, and Metro Lines 2A and 7 have made Malad and Kandivali slots workable in a way the Bandra-Worli Sea Link never did for anyone north of Juhu.

In the Central Suburbs, Powai and Chandivali have no station of their own, so a weekly slot at Hiranandani Gardens depends on JVLR behaving, with tutors coming from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar and the SCLR carrying anyone crossing from Chembur. The Eastern Suburbs, from Chembur and Wadala through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund, run on the Central and Harbour lines and the Eastern Freeway, which is the one road in the city that makes a long slot more reliable rather than less. In Navi Mumbai the nodes do the work: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel are each a short run along Palm Beach Road or the Sion-Panvel Highway, and while the Atal Setu has shortened the island crossing, a tutor crossing the creek weekly for thirty weeks is a promise that usually breaks by November. Thane is the clearest case of all, because Ghodbunder Road sets the clock from the station out to Majiwada and Kasarvadavali.

What all of this means for an ongoing engagement is simple. Ask the tutor where they live before you agree a slot, not after. A family searching 'IGCSE tutors near me Mumbai' and choosing on credentials alone will often hire someone forty minutes further away than they realise, and that gap is paid back in cancellations from August onwards. A slightly less impressive tutor ten minutes away will deliver more sessions over a year than an excellent one who has to cross the city in the rain.

sections.heading: Reading the Mumbai school year before you commit to months
paragraphs: The Mumbai school year opens in June and closes with study leave in the spring, and an engagement should be shaped around four fixed pressure points rather than around a round number of months. Term one to Diwali is when content is delivered and when a tutor can still afford to teach slowly. The weeks after Diwali are when unit tests arrive in clusters. December and January bring the pre-boards or mocks, along with coursework drafts at schools taking that route. February and March are revision and study leave, when sessions get longer and more frequent whether you planned for that or not.

Families booking a home tutor for History (0470) Mumbai schools have already pushed into Year 11 are usually reacting to the second of those points, and that is late but workable. Families booking in June are buying the cheapest version of the same outcome, because the work gets spread across more weeks at fewer hours each. The expensive version is March, when the only available sessions are long, frequent and competing with every other subject in the house.

The schools themselves set the rhythm. Children from Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Bombay International School at Babulnath, Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, NES International School in Mulund West, Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul all arrive with different internal test calendars, and a tutor who has taught students from your school can usually tell you which fortnight will hurt. Naming a school here is local context only. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any school named on this page, and we do not guarantee grades.

One practical consequence: agree in advance what happens during study leave. Most arrangements need more sessions in that period and the tutor's calendar is finite, so the families who ask in November get the extra slots and the families who ask in February get apologies. If your school enters candidates for the October or November series rather than May or June, shift this whole picture by about six months and confirm the series with the examinations officer before planning anything.

sections.heading: Why home tuition in Mumbai holds a routine better than the alternatives
paragraphs: Home tuition wins on consistency, which is the only thing that matters across thirty weeks. The materials stay in one place, the folder does not travel, the tutor knows which drawer the past papers live in, and the session happens at the same table at the same hour every week until the habit does the work instead of the willpower. A student who has to be driven to a centre misses sessions in the monsoon. A student whose tutor arrives at the door misses almost none.

There is a second effect that families notice around week six. Because the tutor is in the house, the parent hears thirty seconds of the handover at the door, and that is worth more than any written report. You learn that your daughter argued well today, or that she has not opened the depth study notes since last Tuesday, and you learn it immediately rather than at the end of the month. Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home classes in Mumbai are the only format where that happens as a side effect rather than as an extra task.

Online has one honest role inside an ongoing arrangement and it is continuity. When a tutor travels for a fortnight, or when a student is recovering from dengue, or when Ghodbunder Road is flooded, an IGCSE online tutor in Mumbai session keeps the week alive instead of surrendering it. Agree that fallback at the start so nobody is negotiating it on a Thursday evening. Treating online as a replacement for the whole engagement is a different decision and a different page.

Hybrid by design, rather than hybrid by accident, suits exactly one group: students whose depth-study specialist lives too far away to come weekly. One travelled session a fortnight plus one screen session a week can work for them if the days are fixed. For everybody else, alternating formats without a rule produces a student who prepares for neither, and an arrangement that quietly halves itself by November while the invoices stay the same size.
bullets: Home tuition keeps materials, table and hour constant across the whole year
The doorstep handover tells a parent more than a monthly written report

sections.heading: Who is coming back to your home every week, and how was that checked?
paragraphs: Before the first session we check government photograph identification against the name on the profile, the qualification claimed, and references from previous families or schools where they exist. We ask which boards and which depth studies the tutor has taught to examination rather than which they studied, because a Modern History degree is not evidence of having marked a Cambridge structured question. For an ongoing engagement we also ask the question that only matters over time: how many standing slots the tutor is already holding, and at what hours.

Your own checks are different from ours and more useful after week one. At the door, note whether the tutor arrives with anything. A tutor carrying a marked answer from last week and a plan for this one is working between sessions. A tutor arriving empty-handed every week for a month is improvising, and improvising is affordable in an eight-week sprint and ruinous over a year. An IGCSE private tutor Mumbai parents keep for a full year is almost always someone whose preparation is visible without being asked for.

Verification also has a month-two version that almost nobody does. Ask to see the running record: which components have been covered, which past questions have been attempted, what the last three marks were. A tutor who can produce that in two minutes has been keeping it. A tutor who promises to send it later and does not has been teaching from memory, which works until the fortnight before the paper when a revision order has to be built from something.

Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, and be equally wary of one who will not say what is not working. The useful tutor tells you in week four that your son will not pass Paper 2 on current effort, and tells you what would change that. The comfortable tutor tells you he is doing well, collects the fee for nine months, and lets the mock deliver the news instead.
bullets: Photograph identification and qualification checked before the first session
Depth studies taught to examination, not subjects studied at university
Watch whether the tutor arrives with last week's marked work in hand
Ask in month two for the running record of components and marks

sections.heading: What does an hourly rate for History home tuition in Mumbai cover?
paragraphs: An hourly rate normally covers the session itself, the planning behind it, and marking of the work set in that session. It normally does not cover marking a full school mock paper, writing a report for the school, attending a parent meeting, extra sessions during study leave, or travel beyond the radius the tutor agreed to. None of that is hidden. It is simply never discussed, and then it becomes an awkward conversation in February when everybody is tired.

IGCSE tuition fees in Mumbai depend on a short and predictable list: the board and level, how scarce the subject specialist is, session length and frequency, the distance travelled, and the volume of marking between sessions. History is less scarce than Further Maths and more scarce than English, and a specific depth study can make a particular tutor rare in a particular suburb. There is no price list here because any figure would be wrong for somebody's subject, somebody's suburb and somebody's month, which is a better reason than modesty.

Billing is usually monthly in advance or at the end of each month, counted in sessions rather than calendar weeks, and the single clause worth insisting on is what happens to a cancelled session. The fair version most tutors already use: the family gives twenty-four hours and the session is rescheduled or not charged, less notice than that and it is charged, and a tutor who cancels makes the time up within a fortnight. Write that down in the first message and it never needs discussing again.

Pausing and ending deserve the same clarity. A pause for a family holiday or a school trip is ordinary and most tutors will hold a slot for two or three weeks, though not indefinitely, because the hour gets offered to somebody else. Ending is easier than families fear: two weeks of notice is normal courtesy, the tutor hands over the running record, and nobody needs to invent a reason. What you should avoid is the slow fade, where sessions get cancelled one at a time until the arrangement dies without anybody deciding. Say it plainly, ask for the notes, and if the subject still needs work, ask us to shortlist again the same week.

sections.heading: What a month of History home tuition looks like, week by week
paragraphs: Week one is diagnostic and should feel slightly uncomfortable. The tutor asks your child to write a short answer cold, reads the last marked work, finds out whether the notes are usable, and sends you two named weaknesses by component the next day. Week two attacks the smaller of the two, because an early visible win buys cooperation from a sceptical fifteen-year-old. Week three sets the first piece of real written homework and reveals whether it gets done. Week four produces a timed answer and the first written update that is worth reading.

That update is how progress reaches a parent between sessions, and it should be three short paragraphs rather than a form. What was covered. What the student can now do that they could not do four weeks ago. What is not happening, usually homework or note-making. History (0470) home classes Mumbai parents are happy with a year later almost always have this rhythm, and the ones that end badly almost always have a tutor who reports only when asked.

Between the written updates, ask for the smaller signal: a two-line message after any session where a marked answer was returned, with the mark and one sentence about why. That is thirty seconds of the tutor's time and it is the difference between knowing in week five that Paper 2 utility answers are still scoring poorly and discovering it at the December mock. If a tutor will not do that, it is worth knowing early.

Across a term, expect the shape rather than a straight line. Four weeks buys a diagnosis and one repaired skill. One term moves a grade for most students whose problem was technique rather than missing content, and moves less for students rebuilding two years of notes. A mock can read worse than a unit test because a full paper under time is a harder thing, and that is information rather than failure. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no honest tutor will put a number on an outcome nine months away.

sections.heading: Starting Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tuition in Mumbai this term
paragraphs: Four things get an arrangement started properly. The year group and the depth study the school chose. Two marked answers photographed with the teacher's comments left in. The slot you can genuinely hold every week, named as a day and an hour rather than as 'evenings'. And how long you want this to run, in months, even if the answer is 'until the mocks and then we will see'.

If you are reading this after the December mocks, say so in your first message, because the shortlist for an exam-term engagement is different: fewer tutors, longer sessions, more marking, and a plan built around question types rather than around the depth study.

Parents often start out searching for the best IGCSE tutor in Mumbai, which is a reasonable instinct and the wrong target. faqs.question: How many hours a week of History home tuition actually help?
faqs.answer: One ninety-minute session a week is enough for most students, as long as something gets written between sessions. Two sessions a week are worth it for a Year 11 with real content gaps, or for a student carrying a depth study they never learned properly. Three rarely helps, because History improves by writing and thinking, and a student in class three evenings a week has no uninterrupted stretch left for either. If you are tempted by three, buy two and protect an hour of written homework instead.

faqs.question: Do we pay monthly or per session, and what does the rate cover?
faqs.answer: Most arrangements are billed monthly, counted in sessions delivered rather than calendar weeks, either in advance or at the end of the month. The rate normally covers the session, the preparation behind it and marking of the work set in that session. It usually excludes marking a full school mock, writing anything for the school, attending a parent meeting at school, and additional sessions during study leave. Ask for all of that in one message before the first session so nothing becomes a negotiation later in the year.

faqs.question: What happens to our weekly evening slot during Diwali and study leave?
faqs.answer: Most families pause through Diwali and most tutors expect that, so say it in October rather than cancelling week by week. Study leave is the opposite situation: demand for sessions goes up, tutors' calendars fill from November onwards, and the families who ask early get the extra hours. If you think you will want two or three sessions a week in February, put that request in writing in November. A tutor cannot create hours in the last fortnight, however good the relationship has been.

faqs.question: Our tutor is away for two weeks in December. Does everything stop?
faqs.answer: Not if you agreed a fallback at the start. The three workable options are an online session for those two weeks, a double session before and after, or a named substitute from the same shortlist who receives the running record. Decide which one you prefer at the beginning, because December is the worst month to improvise: your child is sitting mocks and nobody has spare attention. A tutor who gives you four weeks of notice for planned absence is behaving properly rather than letting you down.

faqs.question: Can one tutor hold the same slot from June right through to the exams?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is the single best predictor of a good outcome, but it has to be asked about at the start. Ask directly how many standing slots the tutor already holds and whether yours could be moved if a board candidate needs that hour in January. An honest answer tells you a lot. Tutors who live within fifteen minutes of your building hold slots for a year far more reliably than ones crossing the city, which matters more than any difference in qualifications.

faqs.question: How do we find out what happened in each week's session?
faqs.answer: Two mechanisms, and you should insist on both. A short written update after every fourth session covering what was taught, what the student can now do, and what is not happening. Plus a two-line message whenever a marked answer is returned, giving the mark and one sentence of explanation. Thirty seconds of writing from the tutor keeps you informed without turning it into an administrative burden. If a tutor resists the smaller of those two, that is worth knowing in week three rather than after the mock.

faqs.question: What is not included in the hourly rate?
faqs.answer: Typically: marking a full mock paper the school has already set, writing a report or reference for the school, attending a school parent meeting, extra sessions during study leave, and travel beyond the radius the tutor agreed to. Also typically excluded is a rewrite of coursework, which no honest tutor should be doing anyway. None of this is a trap. It is simply unstated until February, when everybody is tired and a reasonable request turns into an uncomfortable conversation about money.

faqs.question: How much notice do we give if we want to end the arrangement?
faqs.answer: Two weeks is normal courtesy on both sides and no reason has to be given. Ask the tutor to hand over the running record, which should list components covered, past questions attempted and the last few marks, so a replacement does not start from zero. Avoid the slow fade, where sessions get cancelled one at a time until the arrangement dies unannounced; it wastes a term and leaves the next tutor with nothing. If the subject still needs work, ask us to shortlist again in the same week.

faqs.question: Can we pause for a month and restart without losing the tutor?
faqs.answer: Two or three weeks is usually fine and most tutors will hold the slot. A full month is harder, because that hour gets offered to somebody else and standing slots at 7pm are the scarcest thing a tutor owns. If a long pause is unavoidable, ask whether the tutor will take a reduced online session during it to keep the slot nominally alive, or accept that you may return to a different hour. Say it early rather than cancelling week by week, which reads as the arrangement ending.

faqs.question: Is a term-long engagement better value than an exam-term one?
faqs.answer: Per week of benefit, yes; in total cost, no. A term-long engagement spreads the same work across more weeks at fewer hours each, which suits the way History is actually learned and leaves room to rebuild notes and teach a depth study properly. An exam-term engagement is sharper and shorter and can move a grade, but it cannot replace a missing year. Pick on what your child needs rather than on the total, and let the diagnostic session cast the deciding vote.

faqs.question: Will a tutor travel to Mulund or Thane for a standing weekly slot through the monsoon?
faqs.answer: Tutors who live in Mulund, Thane or along the Eastern Express Highway will; tutors crossing from the Western Suburbs often will not, whatever they say in June. The monsoon is the real test of a weekly arrangement, and Ghodbunder Road in July is where good intentions go to die. Ask where the tutor lives before agreeing a slot, and agree an online fallback for washed-out evenings. Ten minutes of distance delivers more sessions across a year than any amount of enthusiasm.

faqs.question: We like the tutor but have no evidence of improvement. What should we ask for?
faqs.answer: Ask for three specific things in one message: the running record of components covered, the last three marks on written answers with the markscheme band, and what the tutor will do differently over the next four sessions. A tutor who is working will send all three within a day. A tutor who is improvising will send reassurance instead, and that answer is itself the information you needed. If six to eight weeks of kept sessions and completed homework have produced nothing, the match is wrong and we will shortlist again.

sections.heading: Travel time comes first: how we match a Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tutor in Mumbai
paragraphs: Most failed tutoring arrangements in this city are transport failures wearing a subject costume. The tutor was good. The tutor also lived in Chembur and your flat is in Khar West, and for the first three weeks they made it, and in the fourth week the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road did what it does at 6.15pm, and by the seventh week the slot had moved twice and then quietly become fortnightly. So we start at the wrong end of the obvious order. Before we look at who teaches History well, we work out who can stand outside your lift at 6.55pm, every week, from August to April.

That means the first questions are logistical and slightly tedious. Which building, which corridor, which station or highway is closest. Whether the tutor would arrive by car, by rickshaw from a station, or on a two-wheeler, because a two-wheeler changes a Ghodbunder Road journey more than any other variable in Mumbai. Which evenings are genuinely free for the next eight months rather than which evenings are free in principle. And whether a 7.30am weekend slot is on the table, because for several corridors in this city a Saturday morning lesson is worth two weekday evening ones in sheer reliability.

Only then do we look at the subject, and for History that look is narrow rather than broad. We want to know which depth study the school teaches, because a tutor strong on one period is not interchangeable with a tutor strong on another. We want two marked papers, at least one with source questions on it. And we want to know whether the problem is knowledge or writing, which in History is almost never the same problem. A home tutor for History (0470) Mumbai parents keep for two years is chosen for the period and the paper, not for a general reputation.

Every Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tutor in Mumbai we shortlist arrives with a stated travel time to your address and the slots they will genuinely hold, and the list is never longer than three. A paid trial lesson happens at your home, which is deliberate: you learn as much from how the tutor handles your doorway, your dining table and your ten-year-old brother wandering through as you do from the teaching. After it, put the arrangement in writing. The slot, the length, what happens when either side cancels, how homework comes back, and what the four weeks before the series look like.

sections.heading: Which History course is your child actually entered for?
paragraphs: Confirm the syllabus code with the school before you hire anyone, because Cambridge History comes in more than one form and the difference changes the whole teaching job. The IGCSE course is coded 0470. Some centres enter candidates for a differently coded variant with the same content, and there is a separate International AS and A Level History syllabus for the two years afterwards, assessed in a completely different style. One email to the examinations officer settles the code, the series and the components, and it takes less time than reading this paragraph twice.

Establish which course your child is actually entered for matters more in History than in most subjects, because the depth study decision sits inside it. 0470 offers a choice of depth studies, and different Mumbai schools teach different ones, sometimes changing between cohorts when a teacher leaves. A parent who hires a tutor expert in one period for a child studying another has bought a kind tutor and a wasted term. Ask the school which depth study is being taught this year, in writing, and send us that answer. A History (0470) IGCSE Years 9-11 tutor Mumbai families retain across the whole block will plan around that choice from the first lesson.

The other thing to check is where History sits in the option block. In many Mumbai schools it shares a block with Geography, Economics or a second language, which means a child can be pushed into or out of it for timetabling reasons that have nothing to do with aptitude. If your child is choosing options this year, ask which blocks History appears in before the form goes in. Reversing that choice after the year starts is possible in some schools and practically impossible in others.

Treat History as a writing subject with real downstream value, because that framing is what makes a reluctant fifteen-year-old take it seriously. It feeds International AS and A Level History, History in the Diploma Programme (DP) of the International Baccalaureate (IB), and undergraduate law, political science, journalism and public policy. It is a prerequisite for none of them. What it does supply is the ability to read a source, weigh it, and write a position in a paragraph, which is the skill that quietly carries a student through every essay-based subject they will ever take.

sections.heading: Paper 1 structured questions, Paper 2 source investigation and the depth-study choice
paragraphs: 0470 is assessed through Paper 1 structured questions, Paper 2 on source investigation, and a depth study the centre selects. For the number of components, their timings and their mark allocations, use the current Cambridge syllabus document for your child's series and ask the school's Cambridge coordinator to confirm it. Cambridge International Education revises syllabuses on its own schedule, and reproducing last cycle's figures here would do your child no favours. What is stable is the character of the assessment, and that is what a tutor can work on from the first week.

The reliable failure in Paper 1 is not ignorance. It is a child writing everything they know and answering nothing that was asked. A Year 11 student given a question about why a policy failed will often produce three accurate paragraphs of narrative about what the policy was, and score at the bottom of the band, because narrative is not explanation. The tutoring work is structural: identify the command word, decide on a position before writing, support it with specific detail, and then say why that detail supports the position. A tutor sitting beside the child can stop the pen mid-sentence at the exact moment the narrative starts. That interruption, repeated for six weeks, is most of the improvement.

Paper 2 source work is a different muscle and it is the one Mumbai students most often arrive without. The paper does not ask what the source says; it asks what the source is doing and whether you can trust it. So a student has to notice who wrote it, when, for whom, and what they stood to gain, and then use that to weigh it against another source that disagrees. The common error is a paraphrase dressed up as analysis. The fix is a worked example: take two sources that contradict each other, cover the attribution lines, let the student decide which is more reliable, then reveal the attributions and watch the answer change. Do that four times and something clicks that no amount of reading will produce.

The depth study is where a home tutor earns their keep, because depth is cumulative and it cannot be crammed. A student needs a small number of events known in real detail, with dates, names and consequences attached, rather than a wide thin coverage of everything. Building that takes a weekly conversation in which the child explains the material back without notes, gets corrected, and does it again the following week. It is also the part where the format matters: a child reciting a chronology to a tutor across the dining table, being questioned and pushed, is doing something different from a child reading notes aloud to a screen.

sections.heading: Corridor by corridor: who can reach your door across Mumbai
paragraphs: Mumbai, Maharashtra is sixty kilometres long and about four kilometres wide in places, which is why we match along corridors rather than across them. A tutor and a family on the same rail line or the same highway can hold a weekly slot for a full academic year. A tutor crossing the city cannot, however willing they are in week one. Below is how we read each zone when we are placing an IGCSE home tutor in Mumbai, with the specific stretches that decide whether a slot survives. Every Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tutor in Mumbai on our books is recorded against one of these corridors.

In South Mumbai we place tutors within the island: Churchgate, Marine Lines, Girgaon, Grant Road, Byculla, Parel, Lower Parel and Worli. Distances are tiny and the clock is not; the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals can turn an eight-kilometre run into forty minutes after six. Tutors here use the Western Line up to Mumbai Central, the Harbour Line towards Dockyard Road, Metro Line 3 between Cuffe Parade and Bandra Kurla Complex, and the Coastal Road for the northbound leg. The Central Suburbs run on the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, with JVLR and the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road (SCLR) doing the lateral work: Kurla West, Ghatkopar East, Kanjurmarg, Chandivali and Powai. Thane tutors cover Thane; a Mulund West tutor will sometimes cross over for a weekend slot and almost never for a Tuesday evening. sections.heading: What the Mumbai school calendar does to a History student
paragraphs: History is the subject where falling behind is invisible for longest, and the Mumbai calendar is what eventually makes it visible. A child can carry an incomplete set of depth-study notes through two terms without anyone noticing, because the early assessments reward recall and the gap only shows up when a paper asks for sustained explanation. By the time the November or December mock exposes it, there is a fixed number of weeks left. That is why History home tuition started in August behaves completely differently from the same tutoring started in January, even with the same tutor.

The schools whose timetables come up most in our History placements include Gopi Birla Memorial School in Walkeshwar, B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Utpal Shanghvi Global School in Juhu, Podar International School in Santacruz and Powai, Bombay Cambridge International School in Andheri East, Thakur International School in Kandivali East, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, JBCN International School in Parel and Chembur, NES International School in Mulund West, Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of these schools, nor with any other school mentioned on this page. We list them because their term dates and assessment weeks are the real limit on what a tutoring plan can achieve.

The pressure points are consistent year to year. The first graded History assessment of any weight lands in late September or October, and for most families that result is the trigger for the search that brought them to this page. End-of-term examinations fall in November and December, and for Year 11 those are the mocks that produce the predicted grades used by universities and by Indian admissions. January and February are brutal: mock feedback, internal deadlines in four other subjects, and revision for the series all compete for the same weekday evenings. March through May is the series itself. A tutor who starts in October has time to build depth; one who starts in February is choosing which topics to abandon.

There is a second calendar that catches transferring families. A child moving into Cambridge History from an Indian-board Social Science background arrives able to reproduce content accurately and unprepared for a paper that rewards argument, source scepticism and a position taken under time pressure. The same is true in reverse for children arriving from a British curriculum mid-block, who meet a depth study they have never studied. Both cases need six to eight weeks of specific work before any assessment will look normal, and both are easier to fix with someone physically present, because the first few weeks are about watching how the child actually writes.

sections.heading: Why home classes work best for IGCSE History in Mumbai
paragraphs: History rewards the kind of supervision that only works in a room. The core activity is a child writing continuous prose under mild pressure while someone watches the writing happen, and the most valuable intervention is an interruption at the right second: the moment the answer slides from explanation into narrative, the moment a source is paraphrased instead of weighed, the moment a paragraph starts without a position. A Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tutor in Mumbai sitting beside the child can stop the pen there. History (0470) home classes Mumbai families book are therefore doing something structurally different from a lesson about History, which is why we lead with this format rather than treating it as the premium option.

The second reason is the material itself. A depth study lives in a physical set of notes, and those notes are usually a mess: three notebooks, a school handout folder, some printed pages, and a shoebox of past papers. A tutor at the dining table can sort that into one working system in the first two lessons, and can see with their own eyes that the February section has four pages where it needs twenty. This is dull, high-value work and it does not happen remotely, because nobody photographs a disorganised folder honestly.

There is a third reason that parents rarely say out loud, and it is attention. A fifteen-year-old studying a subject they find dry will drift, and drift is visible in a room and invisible on a screen. In-person lessons also reach children who are younger, less organised, or quietly avoiding the subject, which describes a good proportion of IGCSE History students in Mumbai. An IGCSE private tutor Mumbai parents hire for History is usually being hired as much for accountability as for subject expertise.

The honest limits. In-person lessons are constrained by geography, which is why we match by corridor and why a parent in Kasarvadavali has a smaller pool than one in Khar West. They are vulnerable to monsoon and to traffic in a way that remote lessons are not. They cost more where travel is long, because somebody is paying for that hour. For families in the furthest corridors, IGCSE home tuition in Mumbai through the dry months and remote lessons during the monsoon is a sensible hybrid, and families who want an IGCSE online tutor in Mumbai as their main format will find that argued properly on its own page rather than half-argued here.

sections.heading: What to check at your own front door before the second lesson
paragraphs: Before a profile reaches you, a Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tutor in Mumbai has cleared four things: the qualification they claim, verified against documents rather than a CV; a government photo identity, which your society will ask for anyway; a subject teaching demonstration judged by someone who has taught the board, where most applicants are filtered out; and at least one contactable reference from a school or a family. We also record the tutor's home corridor and stated travel time, because an unrealistic travel claim is the most common cause of a match failing in month two.

Someone coming into your home deserves one more layer of your own attention, and it has nothing to do with suspicion. Note the identity details yourself at the first lesson and keep them. Tell your society office the tutor's name and the standing slot rather than letting them arrive as an unregistered visitor each week. Have the lesson in a part of the flat that is visible from the rest of it, not behind a closed bedroom door. Make it normal for someone to walk through. None of this is awkward once it is routine, and every experienced tutor expects it.

Then judge the teaching, which only you can do. Ask which depth study and which papers they have taught, and for which series. Ask what the first four lessons will cover and listen for a diagnosis rather than a tour of the syllabus. Read the first piece of marked homework yourself: comments that explain why a paragraph lost marks are worth more than a grade and a tick. Call the reference. And be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, or who names the number of marks your child will gain, because nobody can read a script that has not been written. IB Gram does not guarantee grades and we do not permit tutors on the platform to suggest otherwise.

Finally, the money, because this is where families get hurt in ways that have nothing to do with teaching. Pay in monthly cycles at most. Never buy a discounted term package before you have seen four weeks of marked work. Keep the slot, the rate, the cancellation terms and the notice period written down even when the tutor came through a neighbour, and especially then. If a tutor asks for a term's fees in advance for an arrangement you have not tested, treat that as a reason to wait a week rather than as a saving.

Register the tutor with your society office as a standing weekly visitor

Read the first marked homework; comments matter more than a grade

sections.heading: What does a tutor sitting beside your child notice that a screen misses?
paragraphs: Four things, and all of them happen in the first twenty minutes. The pen stopping, which means the student has lost the thread and is deciding whether to admit it. The eyes going to the notes before the answer, which means the material is recognised rather than known. The paragraph that starts with a date, which means no position has been decided. And the small physical tell when a question lands on a topic the child has quietly never understood. A tutor in the room reads all four without asking, and acts on them in the same minute. That immediacy is the substance of what you are paying for when you book a home tutor rather than a remote one.

The practical texture of a home lesson in a Mumbai flat is worth describing honestly, because nobody does. The lesson happens at the dining table, which means it happens in the middle of the household. The table has to be cleared properly, not partly, because a History lesson needs the student's three notebooks, the school folder, a past paper and space to write without turning pages sideways. The television goes off, not down. Someone needs to decide where the younger sibling will be for that hour. A tutor who asks for these things on the first visit is not being difficult; they are telling you they intend to teach.

The gate is the other logistical reality, and it decides whether the arrangement is pleasant or exhausting. Most Mumbai societies will register a tutor as a standing weekly visitor once a resident authorises it, which is a one-time conversation at the society office. Without that, the tutor repeats a visitor entry every week: a register, a phone call upstairs, an app notification, sometimes a wait at the gate that eats ten minutes of a sixty-minute lesson. Sort it in the first fortnight. Ask your society whether they want the tutor's identity details on file, whether there is a visitor parking slot if the tutor drives, and whether the lift the tutor will use has any restriction in the evening.

Scheduling is where Mumbai specifically punishes the unprepared. The slots families instinctively want, between 5pm and 7pm on a weekday, are the worst available: the child is tired from school, the tutor is crossing the city in the peak hour, dinner is being made, and nobody is at their best. The slots that actually work are 8pm or later on a weeknight, and 7.30am to 10am at the weekend, which is consistently the most productive hour we see. And the handover at the door is a real part of the service: ninety seconds with the tutor as they leave, hearing what happened, tells a parent more than a monthly written report. Ask for it every week and the whole arrangement improves, because a tutor who knows they will be asked prepares an answer.

sections.heading: How long before a History grade actually moves?
paragraphs: Source technique moves fastest, often inside three or four lessons, because it is a procedure rather than a body of knowledge. By four weeks your child should be able to look at an unseen source and tell you who produced it, when, for whom, and why that matters, without being prompted through the steps. Paper 1 writing structure takes six to eight weeks, because the habit of writing narrative is deeply set and has to be replaced rather than corrected. Depth-study knowledge is the slow one and takes a full term to show in marks, since it is built by weekly recall rather than by explanation.

So the four-week test for a History arrangement is not a mark. It is three things you can check at your own table: your child can describe what last week's lesson fixed, the homework comes back with written reasons rather than ticks, and the notes are visibly becoming one organised system instead of three. If all three are true, keep going even if the next school test is flat, because the mark lags the work in this subject more than in any other. If none is true after a month, change tutors rather than wait for the mock to prove the point.

Over a full examination cycle the honest answer is that outcomes vary widely and the reasons are usually not about History. Students who start early and do the weekly recall tend to move substantially. Students who start in February tend to move a little, in the papers that respond to technique. A minority barely move at all, and in most of those cases the limit was workload across five subjects or a student who had decided the subject was not worth their time. A tutor who identifies that and tells you, rather than proposing a third weekly lesson, is doing the more useful job. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and a tutor who promises a specific grade on a first call has told you what you needed to know about them.

When a match is not working, be concrete with us. Not that it feels off: that no homework has been set for three weeks, that the tutor has rescheduled twice, that your child cannot explain anything from the last lesson, that the slot has drifted from 7pm to 8.30pm. We will usually place a replacement inside the same week, matched on the same corridor so the travel problem does not repeat, and the incoming tutor gets a written handover of what was covered. Changing in week five costs a fortnight. Leaving it until February costs the series, and History is a subject where the series is the whole assessment.
bullets: Source technique should move inside three or four lessons
Paper 1 structure takes six to eight weeks to replace a narrative habit
Depth-study knowledge shows in marks after a full term, not a month
Four-week test: the child explains the fix, homework has written reasons
Replacement matched on the same corridor, with a written handover

sections.heading: Booking IGCSE home tuition in Mumbai for History this term
paragraphs: Three pieces of information get you a shortlist in a day. Your building and corridor, so we can work out who can actually reach you. The depth study your child's school is teaching this year, in the school's own words. And two marked papers, with at least one source question among them. If you have only one of the three, send that one; the corridor is the most useful if you are choosing.

The trial lesson happens at your table and should feel like an assessment of your child rather than a performance by the tutor. Expect them to ask to see the notebooks and the folder, to set a short piece of writing and watch it being written, and to interrupt. Expect the household to be normal rather than staged, because the tutor needs to know what a real Tuesday looks like. At the end you should get a short written plan: the first three things to fix, what weekly homework will be, and when a school assessment should start reflecting it.

We will also tell you when a History (0470) tutor in Mumbai is not what your child needs. Sometimes the real problem is general writing and the right match is an English tutor. Sometimes it is organisation across five subjects, and an IGCSE tutor Mumbai parents would call a study-skills coach fixes more for less. Sometimes a Year 9 student is fine and the answer is to wait six months. We would rather say that than place a tutor who will be let go in November.

On cost, we publish no rate and would be making one up if we did. What IGCSE tuition fees in Mumbai depend on is visible and you can sanity-check it yourself: the board and level, how scarce the subject is in your corridor, how far the tutor travels and by what means, the length and frequency of lessons, and how close the examination series is. In-person lessons in Kasarvadavali or Ulwe price differently from the same lessons in Lower Parel, and the reason is travel rather than teaching.

Get the depth study in writing from the school, not from memory

faqs.question: How do you make sure a tutor can actually reach our home on time every week?
faqs.answer: By matching every Cambridge IGCSE History 0470 home tutor in Mumbai on corridor and travel time before we look at subject fit at all. Each tutor on our books has a recorded base and a stated travel time, and we do not place someone who would cross the city for a weekday evening slot, because those arrangements fail in month two rather than week one. We also ask for your realistic evenings rather than your preferred ones, and we will suggest a weekend morning if your corridor makes weekday arrivals unreliable. A tutor who is twenty minutes late every week is a scheduling error, not a character flaw.

faqs.question: What will our society gate need from the tutor each week?
faqs.answer: Most Mumbai societies will register a tutor as a standing weekly visitor once a resident authorises it at the society office, which is a single conversation rather than a weekly one. Without that, the tutor repeats a full visitor entry every week: the register, a call upstairs, sometimes an app approval, and a wait that can eat ten minutes of the lesson. Sort it in the first fortnight. Ask whether the office wants the tutor's identity details on file, whether there is a visitor parking slot, and whether the lift the tutor uses has any evening restriction.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be at home while the lesson is happening?
faqs.answer: Someone responsible should be in the flat, and that is a reasonable standard rather than a strict rule. It does not mean sitting in the lesson. It means the lesson happens in a visible part of the home, usually the dining area, with the door open and people moving through normally. That arrangement protects the child, protects the tutor, and has the side benefit that you overhear roughly what is being taught. If both parents work late, a grandparent or a trusted adult at home works perfectly well. Tell us at the matching stage if nobody can be there.

faqs.question: Where should the lesson happen if we do not have a separate study room?
faqs.answer: The dining table, fully cleared, with the television off rather than turned down. Most Mumbai flats have no study room and it is not a problem. What a History lesson actually needs is horizontal space for three notebooks, a school folder and a past paper, a chair at the right height, decent light, and nobody else talking in the same room for an hour. Decide in advance where a younger sibling will be. A tutor who asks for these things on the first visit is signalling that they intend to teach rather than to chat.

faqs.question: Can a tutor come to Kasarvadavali on Ghodbunder Road for a 7pm evening slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, but only a tutor based in Thane, and we would push you towards a later or weekend slot. Ghodbunder Road at seven in the evening turns a twenty-minute run from Thane station into close to an hour, and a tutor doing that twice a week will eventually start rescheduling. For this corridor specifically we match within Thane, from Majiwada, Manpada, Waghbil or Kasarvadavali itself, and we recommend an 8pm weeknight start or a 7.30am Saturday. The Saturday morning slot is the most reliable hour available to Ghodbunder Road families.

faqs.question: What happens when a tutor's travel runs late and they arrive twenty minutes down?
faqs.answer: Agree the rule before it happens, in writing, at the start. The usual arrangement is that the tutor makes up the time either in the same session or in the next one, and that repeated lateness triggers a conversation about the slot rather than about the tutor. Mumbai traffic is not a character defect and one late arrival in a term is normal. Three in a month means the travel time was never realistic and the slot needs to move, or the match needs to change. Tell us when it reaches three rather than absorbing it quietly for a term.

faqs.question: Is there parking for a tutor who drives to our building in Powai?
faqs.answer: That depends entirely on your society, and Powai is a zone where it genuinely matters. Powai has no railway station, so tutors arrive by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar, and many drive or ride. Ask your society office whether visitor parking is available in the evening and whether a standing weekly visitor can be allotted a slot. If there is no parking, tell us at the matching stage, because it changes who we shortlist: a tutor arriving by rickshaw from Kanjurmarg has a different reliability profile from one bringing a car.

faqs.question: My son writes everything he knows and still loses marks on Paper 1. Why?
faqs.answer: Because he is writing narrative where the question wants explanation, which is the single most common cause of low Paper 1 marks. Accurate paragraphs describing what happened can score at the bottom of the band if they never say why it mattered or answer the command word. The correction is structural: identify the command word, decide a position before writing, then use specific detail to support that position. It takes six to eight weeks, because the narrative habit has to be replaced rather than patched, and it is much faster with someone watching the writing happen.

faqs.question: How is Paper 2 source work different from what he does at school?
faqs.answer: School often teaches sources as comprehension; the paper treats them as evidence with an agenda. The question is not what the source says but what it is doing: who wrote it, when, for whom, and what they stood to gain, then how that weighs against a source that disagrees. Students who paraphrase well still score poorly here. The quickest way through it is a drill where the attribution lines are covered, the student judges reliability, and then the attributions are revealed and the judgement changes. Four rounds of that usually does more than a term of reading.

faqs.question: Which depth study should he choose, and can a tutor help with that?
faqs.answer: Usually the school chooses, not the student, and that is the first thing to confirm in writing because different Mumbai schools teach different depth studies and some change between cohorts. A tutor can help enormously once the choice is known, and almost not at all before, since depth means a small number of events known in real detail rather than wide coverage. Send us the school's answer and we will shortlist tutors strong on that specific period, because expertise in one depth study does not transfer to another the way general subject knowledge does.

faqs.question: What do IGCSE tuition fees in Mumbai depend on for a History tutor?
faqs.answer: Five things, none of which we will reduce to a published number because any figure here would be invented. The board and level set the baseline. Subject scarcity matters, and Cambridge History specialists are thinner on the ground in this city than Mathematics or Science tutors. Travel distance and mode matter a great deal for in-person lessons. Lesson length and frequency change the monthly total more than the hourly rate does. And proximity to the examination series moves prices upward, which is one more argument for starting in the first term.

faqs.question: We like the tutor but marks are flat after six weeks. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Separate the three timelines before deciding, because History moves at three different speeds. Source technique should have improved by now, so if it has not, that is a real signal. Paper 1 structure is right at the edge of its window at six weeks. Depth-study knowledge will not show in a mark for a full term. So check the leading indicators instead: can he explain what last week fixed, does homework come back with written reasons, are the notes becoming one organised system. If those are all yes, hold. If they are no, tell us and we will replace within the week.
